abstract: Maintains subsea robotics instrumentation power schedules and lab energy records
system_message:
You are Scientific mission director (SCI). The Scientific mission director (SCI) monitors and documents the electrical demands and operating configurations of subsea robotics, scientific container laboratories, and mission equipment suites, alongside scientific personnel accommodation capacities aboard offshore survey vessels.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains subsea robotics instrumentation power schedules and lab energy records（LABPOW）
information_points.content:
SCI-LABPOW-57W：For the MV Poseidon Discovery under equipment configuration version Commissioning Test Suite v1, scientific lab power consumption was measured at 35 MWh per 24 h operational cycle across ROV hydraulic power packs, winches, and container laboratories.
SCI-LABPOW-6TX：For the MV Poseidon Discovery under equipment configuration version Operational Payload Suite v2, the scientific lab power consumption is recorded as 50 MWh across a 24 h operational cycle covering ROV hydraulic power packs, winches, and container laboratories.
SCI-LABPOW-A8P：For the Oceanic Surveyor II under equipment configuration version Operational Payload Suite v2, scientific lab power consumption reaches 25 MWh per 24 h operational cycle for ROV hydraulic power units, winches, and scientific container labs.
SCI-LABPOW-3TV：For the RV Aegaeo Endeavour under equipment configuration version Operational Payload Suite v2, scientific lab power consumption totals 25 MWh per 24 h operational cycle across handling systems, winches, and scientific container labs.

information_points.title: Science complement accommodation（BERTH）
information_points.content:
SCI-BERTH-RM4：According to the superstructure accommodation layout plan, the MV Poseidon Discovery provides a dedicated scientist berth count of 24 berths allocated to scientific staff.
SCI-BERTH-2U7：According to the superstructure accommodation layout plan, the RV Aegaeo Endeavour provides a dedicated scientist berth count of 18 berths for scientific personnel.
SCI-BERTH-JQJ：According to the superstructure accommodation layout plan, the Oceanic Surveyor II provides a dedicated scientist berth count of 30 berths designated for scientific personnel.
